title: Lesson Report – Internal Remark Labels – English and Japanese UI – Updated labels displayed
description: AC 108358.1 — Component and Negative — Salesforce displays the specified English and Japanese labels instead of the legacy labels.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce and can open an editable Lesson Report.\n- A Lesson Report exists with the internal-remark field visible in the English UI.\n- The same Lesson Report is accessible in the Japanese UI.
steps_actions:
1. HQ or CM Staff opens the Lesson Report in the English UI.
2. HQ or CM Staff inspects the same field label in the English UI.
3. HQ or CM Staff switches to the Japanese UI and opens the same Lesson Report.
4. HQ or CM Staff inspects the same field label in the Japanese UI.
steps_result:
1. The internal-remark field label displays exactly Remark (Internal Only).
2. The label Remarks is not displayed for the internal-remark field.
3. The internal-remark field label displays exactly 特筆事項（社内用).
4. The label 備考 is not displayed for the internal-remark field.
steps_data:
1. locale = English; expected_label = Remark (Internal Only)
2. legacy_label = Remarks
3. locale = Japanese; expected_label = 特筆事項（社内用)
4. legacy_label = 備考

title: Lesson Report – Content Requiredness – Optional on SF and BO – Blank value saved
description: AC 108358.2 — Decision Table and Equivalence Partitioning — Both report surfaces present Content as optional and retain a blank value after save.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce and Back Office.\n- An editable Lesson Report exists on Salesforce and its corresponding Back Office report is accessible.\n- Lesson_Report_Require_Fields_Setting in Back Office configures Content/[公開]授業内容 as optional.
steps_actions:
1. HQ or CM Staff opens the editable Lesson Report in Salesforce.
2. HQ or CM Staff clears Content/[公開]授業内容 and saves the Salesforce report.
3. HQ or CM Staff opens the corresponding editable Lesson Report in Back Office.
4. HQ or CM Staff clears Content/[公開]授業内容 and saves the Back Office report.
steps_result:
1. The Content/[公開]授業内容 label does not display an asterisk.
2. The Salesforce report saves and Content remains blank after refresh.
3. The Content/[公開]授業内容 label does not display an asterisk.
4. The Back Office report saves and Content remains blank after refresh.
steps_data:
1. surface = Salesforce; content = blank; expected_required = false
2. surface = Salesforce; content = blank
3. surface = Back Office; config = Lesson_Report_Require_Fields_Setting; content = blank; expected_required = false
4. surface = Back Office; content = blank

title: Lesson Report – Group Lesson Layout – Report Fields – Specified sequence displayed
description: AC 108358.3 — Component and Scenario — Salesforce displays every group-lesson field in the specified relative order.
preconditions: - HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.\n- An editable Group Lesson Report exists with values in Homework Completion, In-Lesson Quiz, Understanding, Remark (Internal Only), and CM Note.
steps_actions: 1. HQ or CM Staff opens the editable Group Lesson Report in Salesforce.\n2. HQ or CM Staff reads the fields from the first listed field to the last listed field.
steps_result: 1. The Group Lesson Report displays Homework Completion, In-Lesson Quiz, Understanding, Remark (Internal Only), and CM Note.\n2. The fields appear in this exact relative order: Homework Completion, In-Lesson Quiz, Understanding, Remark (Internal Only), CM Note.
steps_data: 1. teaching_method = Group\n2. expected_order = 1 Homework Completion; 2 In-Lesson Quiz; 3 Understanding; 4 Remark (Internal Only); 5 CM Note
